title: Nintendo 64 Cartridge Size Myth

scenes.text: The 64‑megabit N64 cartridge seemed tiny for a 3D game.
People think the cartridge couldn't hold large game worlds because of its small memory.
scenes.label: Cartridge Too Small

scenes.text: In reality the 64‑megabit (8 MB) ROM stored data efficiently, and developers used compression and streaming to fit expansive worlds.
scenes.label: Efficient Compression

scenes.text: Smart coding made the N64 legendary.
scenes.label: Smart Coding
scenes.sub: Compression turned 8 MB into massive worlds

scenes.text: Follow for the future, one byte at a time.

description: Explore why the Nintendo 64 cartridge wasn't a limitation and how developers overcame it. Dive into the real tech behind the myth. Follow for more myth‑busting tech facts! #shorts #fyp #gaminghistory #N64 #retro #techmyth #gamedev #gaming
